sentence: She ______ her jacket before going outside.
explanation: El phrasal verb <put on> significa ponerse una prenda de ropa.

sentence: I need to ______ the answer to this question.
explanation: El phrasal verb <find out> significa descubrir información.

sentence: He ______ the form at the doctor's office.
explanation: El phrasal verb <fill in> significa completar un formulario con información.

sentence: We ______ at the hotel at 3 pm.
explanation: El phrasal verb <check in> significa registrarse en un hotel.

sentence: Can you ______ the music? I can't hear you.
explanation: El phrasal verb <turn down> significa bajar el volumen.

sentence: She ______ her old clothes to charity.
explanation: El phrasal verb <give away> significa donar o regalar algo.

sentence: They ______ the meeting until next week.
explanation: El phrasal verb <put off> significa posponer o aplazar.

sentence: She was walking on air after getting the job. This means she was very ______.
explanation: El modismo <walking on air> significa sentirse extremadamente feliz.

sentence: He's feeling blue today. This means he's feeling ______.
explanation: El modismo <feeling blue> significa sentirse triste o deprimido.

sentence: She ______ to the park yesterday. (Change: 'She goes' → past continuous)
explanation: Pasado continuo: <was/were> + verbo-ing. She <was going>.

sentence: They ______ dinner when the phone rang. (past continuous)
explanation: Pasado continuo con they: <were> + verbo-ing: <were having>.

sentence: I ______ to the cinema tomorrow. (Change: present → future with 'will')
explanation: Futuro simple: <will> + forma base: <will go>.

sentence: He ______ the homework yet. (Change: 'He finishes' → present perfect negative)
explanation: Presente perfecto negativo: <hasn't> + participio pasado: <hasn't finished>.

sentence: ______ you ever been to London? (present perfect question)
explanation: Pregunta en presente perfecto: <Have> + sujeto + participio pasado.

sentence: The act of moving to a new country is called ______.
explanation: Agregar <-tion> al verbo <migrate> forma el sustantivo <migration>.

sentence: The state of being happy is called ______.
explanation: Agregar <-ness> a <happy> forma el sustantivo <happiness>.

sentence: Something done in a quick way is done ______.
explanation: Agregar <-ly> al adjetivo <quick> forma el adverbio <quickly>.

sentence: A person who manages is a ______.
explanation: Agregar <-er> a <manage> forma el sustantivo <manager>.

sentence: The improve______ of the road took two months.
explanation: Agregar <-ment> a <improve> forma el sustantivo <improvement>.

sentence: She ______ to the party last night. (Correct: 'She goed' → fix the error)
explanation: <Go> es irregular. El pasado es <went>, no <goed>.

sentence: He ______ his homework every day. (Correct: 'He do his homework' → fix)
explanation: La tercera persona singular usa <does>, no <do>: <He does>.

sentence: They ______ playing football now. (Correct: 'They is playing' → fix)
explanation: Con <they>, usa <are>: <They are playing>.

sentence: I have ______ to Paris twice. (Correct: 'I have went' → fix)
explanation: El presente perfecto usa el participio pasado: <have been>, no <have went>.

sentence: She ______ up the phone quickly. (Correct: 'She hanged up' → fix)
explanation: El pasado de <hang up> (colgar el teléfono) es <hung up>, no <hanged up>.

sentence: He turned ______ the job offer because the salary was too low.
explanation: El phrasal verb <turn down> significa rechazar una oferta.
